name: ai-collab
description: Team marketplace: shared Claude Code plugins (skills, subagents, hooks) for AI-assisted multi-repo collaboration on GitHub.

plugins.name: team-ai-workflow
plugins.description: Guard-rail hooks (protected paths, no commits on main, no force-push to shared branches, auto-format), skills (design, check-overlap, implement-issue, create-pr, review-pr, fix-ci, split-pr, triage-issue, write-adr, onboard) and review subagents. Pulls in ai-design for the writing and UI standard.

plugins.name: ai-design
plugins.description: Writing and UI standard from jungrok5/ai-design: polish-writing and polish-ui skills, the design system "Clear", and a style check after every edit. Pinned to a reviewed commit; required by team-ai-workflow.

plugins.name: team-ai-community
plugins.description: Opt-in skills contributed by team members (lighter review). Promote to team-ai-workflow once the team relies on one.
